items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: suggested that we do a tribute to Andy Razaf

ctx.x: Well, as a result of the earlier session for Period Records, Leonard got in touch with me and suggested that we do a tribute to Andy Razaf.
As you know, at that particular time, Andy had been ill for quite some time. He was paralyzed from his waist down.
